item.title: What’s your favorite canon?
item.content:encoded:
Personally. I’m a fan of the resurrection canon. Even though they killed off one of my favorite characters, Dr. Kondraki I like the idea of continuing the central storyline of The SCP Foundation.

And it has some truly awesome moments. Like agents Adams and iris taking on an army of replicating
Zombies.

That secured as my favorite in my book.
